novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement route—“a low-dimensional linear direction in the residual stream that activates when the model has internally committed to a final answer”—rather than merely observing answer stabilization, and it further hypothesizes causal effects from “adding the direction” and “ablating it.” The closest prior work found through searches for “reasoning model commitment vector,” “residual stream answer stabilization,” “causal activation steering early exit CoT,” and “reasoning trajectory termination representation” includes Dynamic Early Exit in Reasoning Models (2025), Certaindex (2024), and LLM Reasoning as Trajectories: Step-Specific Representation Geometry and Correctness Signals (2026): these predict or exploit stabilization/termination signals, but do not establish the claimed single causal commitment direction. The step from those works to this claim is a natural extension with a substantive new core relationship—linear residual encoding plus causal commitment control—rather than a direct transfer or mere object substitution, warranting high but not paradigm-level novelty.
